name: Trumpets Feast Of
overview: The Feast of Trumpets, observed on the first day of the seventh month, is a sacred assembly marked by the blowing of trumpets and a cessation of regular work, as instructed in Leviticus 23:24-25 and Numbers 29:1. This holy convocation involves specific offerings, including burnt offerings of young bullocks, rams, and lambs without blemish, accompanied by flour mixed with oil, symbolizing a sweet savor unto the LORD. Historically, it was celebrated with joy after the captivity, emphasizing both reverence and thanksgiving in worship.
